Name: RefScan - Dominator reference census
Description: READ-ONLY diagnostic. Dumps the ProjectileSettings table, every ProjectileWeapon projectile reference, every LDLD table header, and the raw enemy-weapon component tables to %LOCALAPPDATA%/Hd2ProjRecon/refscan_*.txt. Writes nothing to game memory. Used to find a projectile record that is provably unreferenced so the Dominator's UNSAFE round can be cloned to 380 m/s safely.

Options.Name: RefScan
Options.Description: Read-only reference census. Run one mission, then check Hd2ProjRecon for refscan_*.txt.
